status_filter.rationale: Only orders with confirmed spend are included. Aceptada = accepted by supplier. Recepcion Conforme = goods/services received and approved.

amount_field.description: Net amount per line item, normalised to CLP. Item-level — additive across rows without double-counting.
amount_field.note: MontoTotalOC is an order-level total repeated on every line item; summing it causes double-counting.

compra_agil_filter.rule: Rows where ProveedorSeleccionado = NO are excluded (losing quotes, not actual spend).
compra_agil_filter.rut_mismatch: Orders where ProveedorRUT != RUTProveedorCotizacion are flagged in logs but kept.
